note: Small South Fabius River access of fields and timber north of Philadelphia. Camping is at the one gravel lot at the end of County Road 123, in woods; the river is reached by a short foot path. No amenities. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: brochure 'Camping is allowed on or adjacent to all area parking lots... No amenities are provided', 14 days in 30; map (12/28/2021) puts a Primitive Camping symbol at the single P at the end of CR 123; GIS camp 196 / lot 98. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights written manual. Pin fine. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; brochure 'Camping is allowed on or adjacent to all area parking lots. No unattended open campfires allowed. No amenities are provided. Groups of more than 10 campers require a special use permit. Stays are limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period.' The map marks 'Primitive Camping' beside the only parking lot, and GIS has camping point 196 there - a designated spot at the lot (the 'on or adjacent to parking lots' pattern with a mapped camping point), not a boat-ramp lot (the area has no ramp). Imagery: a ~25 x 20 m gravel lot at the end of a gravel road in woods; a 23-ft rig fits. Access: County Road 123 runs straight north from Route J to the lot; the road does not cross the river (the 'ford' of the name is on the river, not the route). No 4WD/rig wording.
PIN: stored 39.88906,-91.76024 = GIS 196 on the lot's east edge (lot 98 17 m W). Fine.

WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): area page 'Access to the river is by a short foot path off the area's parking lot.' On imagery the South Fabius is ~150-200 m north of the lot through continuous woods.

Note rewritten: acreage, generic MDC text, the 14-day limit (now booking.max_stay_nights) and directions dropped; the lot and river path put in. 'No amenities' kept as the brochure's own words (also covers no toilet/water, which no field records).
